newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Electronic Resources in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Resources in rights issue.

text.p: Electronic Resources Ltd said on Thursday that it was proposing a one-for-two rights issue to raise about Singapore $126.9 milion.
The company said the rights shares would priced at S$1.30 a share. The issue is subject to approvals from shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
It said in a statement the aim of the rights issue was to strengthen the company's capital base in line with its growing operations.
About S$70 million would be used to finance the group's purcahse of inventory and S$55 million to refinance borrowings and the balance used as working capital, the statement said.
NM Rothschild & Sons Singapore Ltd and ABN AMRO (Asia) Ltd will manage and underwrite the issue, it added.
